title: TofuSMP
description: Just a Simple SMP Server From Indonesia.
body:
# TofuSMP


Welcome to TofuSMP, a simple yet enjoyable Minecraft Survival Multiplayer server based in **Indonesia**. Our goal is to provide a relaxed, community-driven experience where players can build, explore, and play together without unnecessary complexity. Whether you're a casual player looking for a peaceful place to create your dream base or someone who enjoys collaborating with others, TofuSMP offers a **welcoming environment** for everyone.


## 📜 Versions

The server runs on Paper and supports multiple Minecraft versions through **ViaVersion** and **ViaBackwards**, allowing players on different versions to join with ease. We also support **Geyser**, enabling both **Java and Bedrock Edition** players to play together seamlessly.


## 🚀 Features

To enhance the vanilla experience while keeping the gameplay familiar, TofuSMP includes several quality of life features such as **land claims** to protect your builds, **voice chat, player trading, daily rewards, public warps, player warps**, and **EssentialsX** commands. These additions make everyday gameplay more convenient without changing the core survival experience.


## 👥 Community

Our community values respect and cooperation. We strive to maintain a **friendly atmosphere** where players can enjoy Minecraft together. **Griefing** is **NOT tolerated**, and everyone is encouraged to help create a positive environment for both new and experienced players.

Whether you're from Indonesia or anywhere else in the world, you're **welcome** to join our growing community.

### 🌐 Website:
**https://tofusmp.carrd.co**
### 🎮 Address:
**tofusmp.my.id**
### 📍 Bedrock Port:
**19155**

We look forward to seeing you in TofuSMP. **Happy crafting!**
